import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int BIG = 12345678;
    
    static class Point {
        int r, c, idx;
        Point() {}
        Point(int r, int c) { this.r = r; this.c = c; }
        Point(int r, int c, int idx) { this.r = r; this.c = c; this.idx = idx; }
    }
    
    static class Holder {
        int[] nums = new int[1000];
        int sz;
        boolean used;
    }
    
    static Holder[][] cells;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] graph;
    static int N, T;
    static int[] L = new int[1000];
    static int[] R = new int[1000];
    static int[] seen = new int[1000];
    static char[][] g1, g2;
    static int[][] D1, D2;
    static Queue<Point> Q = new LinkedList<>();
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        D1 = new int[N+1][N+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(D1[i], BIG);
        
        g1 = new char[N][N];
        g2 = new char[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            g1[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            g2[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        
        // BFS1 from each 'Z'
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Point p = new Point(i, j);
                    BFS1(p);
                }
        
        // Initialize cells
        cells = new Holder[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                cells[i][j] = new Holder();
        
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(g2[i][j])) {
                    int k = g2[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) cells[i][j].used = true;
                    cells[i][j].sz = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
                        cells[i][j].nums[l] = cnt++;
                }
        
        // Initialize graph
        graph = new ArrayList[1000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        
        cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(g1[i][j])) {
                    int k = g1[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Point p = new Point(i, j, cnt++);
                        BFS2(p);
                    }
                }
        
        System.out.println(bipartite(cnt - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
    
    static void BFS1(Point s) {
        int i = s.r, j = s.c;
        D1[i][j] = 0;
        Q.clear();
        Q.add(s);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Point p = Q.poll();
            i = p.r; j = p.c;
            if (g1[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
            int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nr = i + dr[d];
                int nc = j + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < N && nc >= 0 && nc < N) {
                    if (D1[nr][nc] > D1[i][j] + 1) {
                        D1[nr][nc] = D1[i][j] + 1;
                        Q.add(new Point(nr, nc));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void BFS2(Point s) {
        D2 = new int[N+1][N+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(D2[i], BIG);
        int i = s.r, j = s.c;
        D2[i][j] = 0;
        Q.clear();
        Q.add(s);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Point p = Q.poll();
            i = p.r; j = p.c;
            if (D2[i][j] > T) continue;
            if (g1[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (cells[i][j].used) {
                if (D2[i][j] <= T && D2[i][j] <= D1[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= cells[i][j].sz; k++)
                        graph[s.idx].add(cells[i][j].nums[k]);
                }
            }
            if (D2[i][j] >= D1[i][j]) continue;
            int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
            int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nr = i + dr[d];
                int nc = j + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < N && nc >= 0 && nc < N) {
                    if (D2[nr][nc] > D2[i][j] + 1) {
                        D2[nr][nc] = D2[i][j] + 1;
                        Q.add(new Point(nr, nc));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean augment(int u) {
        if (seen[u] == 1) return false;
        seen[u] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = graph[u].get(i);
            if (L[v] == -1) {
                L[v] = u;
                R[u] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (augment(L[v])) {
                L[v] = u;
                R[u] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int bipartite(int m) {
        Arrays.fill(L, -1);
        Arrays.fill(R, -1);
        boolean done;
        do {
            done = true;
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++)
                if (R[i] == -1 && augment(i))
                    done = false;
        } while (!done);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++)
            if (R[i] != -1) ans++;
        return ans;
    }
}
